meta.name: squeeze-page-builder
meta.description: Build email capture landing pages (squeeze pages) as single self-contained HTML files. Triggers on: "build a squeeze page", "email capture page", "lead magnet page", "create an opt-in page", "build an email list page", "lead capture landing page", "create a freebie page", "build a page to collect emails", "opt-in landing page", "email signup page for [product/niche]", "create a lead magnet landing page", "build a page that captures emails before sending to affiliate offer".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成用于收集邮件的独立HTML落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想通过落地页获取潜在客户邮件
copy.tagline_en: Build standalone HTML squeeze pages to capture emails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to capture leads with a squeeze page

howto.what: 当您要求后，Claude 会生成一个用于收集电子邮件地址的落地页（squeeze page），包含免费资源（lead magnet）和提交后跳转到联盟营销链接的功能，输出为单个自包含的 HTML 文件。
howto.when: 当您说出“build a squeeze page”、“email capture page”、“lead magnet page”等短语时触发。
howto.what_en: When asked, Claude builds an email capture landing page (squeeze page) as a single self-contained HTML file, offering a free lead magnet in exchange for email and redirecting to an affiliate offer on form submission.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "build a squeeze page", "email capture page", "lead magnet page", or similar phrases.

say_en.text: Build a squeeze page for a free SEO checklist, redirect to Semrush.
say_en.note: Generates an HTML page with SEO checklist and Semrush redirect.

say_en.text: Create an email capture page with purple scheme for template pack.
say_en.note: Generates a purple-themed landing page for template pack.

say_en.text: Build a lead magnet page that redirects to my affiliate offer.
say_en.note: Generates a page that collects email then redirects to affiliate link.
